goal: Den minimalen produktiven read-only Database-Readiness-Health-Provider ausschließlich aus I74, I76 und I78 implementieren

guide_delta.summary: I79 implementiert einen dünnen HealthReadPort-Provider auf geliehener Connection: I74-Readiness wird exakt nach I76 auf OK/ERROR projiziert; I78-Close-Ownership bleibt beim äußeren Composition-Owner.

tests_required: compile health_provider.py and focused provider test
SELECT 1 plus schema identity maps to OK
SQLite read failure maps to ERROR
schema identity failure maps to ERROR
provider does not own or close the borrowed connection
tests_explicitly_not_run: full suite because the change is one isolated provider
TUI runtime tests because runtime wiring is unchanged
browser tests because Web is untouched
repository/CP-03 regression because schema and storage are untouched
visual evidence because no UI changes exist
risks: provider is not yet wired into a productive TUI composition root
later wiring must preserve one borrowed read-only connection and separate writer ownership
non_changes: no TUI runtime or TuiCatalogReadAdapter changes
no events or writer lifecycle changes
expected_side_effects: a concrete HealthReadPort-compatible database readiness source now exists
the provider remains independently injectable and lifecycle-neutral
